contact.full_name: A M O L G O M K AL E

data.summary:
Business Consulting professional with 15 years of expertise driving enterprise-scale technology and business transformation across Banking and Investment sectors. Proven track record in orchestrating large-scale initiatives, including Data Warehousing, Customer Onboarding, and Payment Network Compliance that enhance operational efficiency, regulatory adherence, and customer experience.
Expert at bridging business and technology stakeholders to deliver complex programs, from concept through execution, leveraging Agile methodologies and deep analytical capabilities. Core competencies include Product Ownership, Enterprise Data Management, Process Transformation, and strategic stakeholder influence within global financial institutions.

raw_sections.experience:
E x p e r i e n c e
Lead Business Analyst | Brillio Technologies | Pune, India
Sept 2024 – June 2026
Franklin Templeton – Alternative Investments Data Ingestion, Transformation & Reporting Enablement
Delivered an enterprise Data Warehouse by consolidating and standardizing data from multiple investment source systems, providing a trusted data foundation for reporting, analytics, operational oversight, and regulatory compliance across alternative asset classes.
Directed requirement gathering, validation, and documentation for Alternative Investment asset classes including Private
Equity, Real Estate, and Hedge Funds ensuring full alignment with business goals.
Spearheaded project scoping, solution architecture, and Proof-of-Concept (POC) execution, establishing clear delivery
roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
Developed executive dashboards and KPI reporting frameworks, leveraging data visualization to drive strategic decision-
making and program governance.
Executed comprehensive legacy system analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target mapping for investment accounting
platforms (BlackRock eFront, Broadridge, SEI) and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics CRM).
Designed conceptual and canonical data models and scalable transformation logic, effectively bridging the gap between
complex business requirements and robust technical data solutions.
Streamlined end-to-end data pipelines, including ingestion, validation, reconciliation, and reporting workflows, resulting in
enhanced data integrity and operational efficiency.
Fiserv – Payment Network Regulatory & Scheme Compliance Transformation
Delivered payment network enhancements to support evolving Visa and Mastercard scheme mandates, ensuring regulatory compliance and seamless processing across authorization, clearing, settlement, and dispute management functions.
Drove card scheme compliance initiatives aligned with Visa and Mastercard mandates, successfully mitigating regulatory risk
while advancing key acquiring business objectives.
Owned and prioritized the end-to-end product backlog for enterprise initiatives, including 6-to-8 Digit BIN migration and
Online Refund Authorization, modernizing transaction processing capabilities.
Conducted end-to-end impact analysis across the full transaction lifecycle, authorization, clearing, settlement, and
downstream acquiring systems ensuring robust, error-free transaction processing.
Facilitated high-stakes alignment between Product, Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams to proactively manage
delivery dependencies, reduce time-to-market, and optimize implementation roadmaps.
Assessed the impact of evolving regulatory and card scheme requirements, translating compliance obligations into actionable
business and technology initiatives.
Product Owner & Business Analyst | Kotak Mahindra Bank | Mumbai, India
Aug 2021 – Aug 2024
Digital Account Opening & Onboarding Transformation
Spearheaded the modernization of digital account onboarding capabilities by defining business requirements, customer journeys, and integration strategies across banking channels and third-party services.
Led business analysis and product ownership for digital onboarding and account opening journeys across web and mobile
banking platforms.
Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE analysis of digital onboarding processes across customer verification, KYC/AML, sanctions
screening, fraud controls/prevention, and account processing, ensuring regulatory compliance.
Defined business workflows, functional requirements, integration touchpoints, validation rules, and exception handling
scenarios across CRM, Core Banking, KYC/AML, and compliance systems.
Achieved ~50% reduction in manual effort, 21% improvement in operational productivity, and reduced onboarding
turnaround time from 7 days to ~24 hours through onboarding workflow automation and digitization.
Senior Business Analyst | Axis Bank | Mumbai, India
May 2019 – Aug 2021
Core Banking Modernization & Compliance Transformation
Led business process transformation initiatives within core banking operations, driving regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and risk mitigation through workflow automation, control optimization, and reporting enhancements.
Drove core banking modernization and compliance automation across STP enablement, Re-KYC, Video KYC, AML, and audit
management workflows.
Analyzed business requirements across Credit Risk and Finance domains, including exposures, collateral management,
guarantees, reconciliations, and accounting controls.
Defined workflow and process automation requirements, exception handling, and integrations across Finacle Core Banking
and compliance platforms.
Performed impact assessments, stakeholder workshops, SIT/UAT, and production rollouts for regulatory and workflow
transformations.
Delivered ~80% process efficiency gains through workflow automation, STP enablement, and compliance digitization.
Business Analyst | YES Bank | Mumbai, India
Nov 2018 – Apr 2019
Customer Master Data Management & UCIC Consolidation
Drove implementation of a UCIC program to establish a unique customer identifier across banking systems through customer record consolidation. Defined business rules, data quality standards, and integration requirements to support regulatory compliance.
Defined business requirements for a rule-based UCIC consolidation platform supporting automated customer matching and
identity resolution.
Analyzed customer master data, duplicate records, and reconciliation processes to improve customer identification accuracy
and data quality.
Authored business requirements, use cases, process flows, and wireframes to support solution design, development, and
testing activities.
Business Analyst / Client Advisory | HDFC Bank | Mumbai, India
Jan 2013 – Nov 2018
Wealth Management Advisory Platform Transformation
Contributed to the implementation of wealth management analytics capabilities for customer interaction management, profiling, and risk assessment, supporting data-driven investment decisions and personalized advisory services.
Contributed to wealth management technology initiatives focused on customer profiling, risk assessment, portfolio advisory,
and HNW analytics capabilities supporting personalized investment recommendations.
Contributed to digitization of NRI account opening journeys through onboarding workflow redesign, document validation,
and compliance checks to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
Managed relationships with High Net Worth and NRI clients, providing advisory-led banking and investment solutions while
supporting portfolio growth and revenue generation.
Customer Services Officer | ICICI Bank | Pune, India
May 2011 – Oct 2012
Retail Banking Operations & Customer Relationship Management
Managed customer servicing and retail banking operations, providing end-to-end support across banking products, account servicing, and relationship management while ensuring compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.
Handled day-to-day retail banking operations including customer onboarding, account maintenance, KYC verification,
transaction processing, and service request management across multiple banking products.
